scripts.build: cd evm && forge build && for c in SkechGame SkechIOU SkechRevenue; do forge inspect $c abi --json > abi/$c.json; done
scripts.test:check: cd evm && FORGE_SNAPSHOT_CHECK=true forge test && bun layout.ts --check
scripts.abi: cd evm && forge build --silent && for c in SkechGame SkechIOU SkechRevenue; do forge inspect $c abi --json > abi/$c.json; done
scripts.solana:test: cd solana && anchor build && cargo test -p tests
scripts.solana:snapshot: cd solana && anchor build && SNAPSHOT=1 cargo test -p tests compute_units
scripts.conformance: bun conformance/generate.ts --check && bun solana/tests/vectors/ladder.ts --check && (cd evm && forge test --match-contract 'ConformanceCases|LadderVectorsTest') && (cd solana && cargo test -p tests conformance && cargo test -p tests ladder)
